messages:
sam_ops: Heads up — ap-east1 shows lots of tiny-gang pods (gpu.size=tiny) being scheduled across racks, causing fragmentation and a rise in evictions.
meera_sre: Yep, eviction_rate for tiny pods up x3 in last 30m. Most nodes still low GPU util but pods spread due to az_balance preference.
jad_sched: We rolled a change to prefer AZ diversity last week to reduce inter-AZ egress during training. Seems it's over-weighting tiny gangs.
taylor_infra: Can we do a conditional scoring tweak so tiny gangs prefer binpack but larger gangs keep az_balance?
sam_ops: Example scheduler score line:
```
SCORE pod=translate-mini score=8 (az_balance:10, binpack:-3, rack_local:1)
```
meera_sre: ops-bot, run quick probe for gpu_temp, gpu_util, evict_rate for top 8 nodes in ap-east1-b.
ops-bot: probe started. Returning top nodes and metrics in ~60s.
ops-bot: probe result: nodes with highest tiny-pod evict_rates: node-a-09(0.11), node-a-22(0.08). avg_gpu_temp normal (~62C). link latency nominal.
jad_sched: Plan: push a 20m canary in ap-east1-b: for pods with label gpu.size=tiny set az_balance weight -6 -> 2 and binpack -3 -> 5. Auto-rollback if any node gpu_util >90% for 45s or evictions increase.
meera_sre: Add telemetry tag sched-canary=2026-03-21-aeb so we can filter.
sam_ops: Go for it. Start canary and we'll monitor evictions and P99 latency.
ops-bot: canary applied at 6570001100. Monitoring eviction_rate, gpu_util, gpu_temp.
meera_sre: 10m check: evictions down ~53% for tiny workloads; no thermal or util alarms. Packing improved (avg pods per node +1).
jad_sched: If stable for full window we'll roll to ap-east1-a then ap-east1-c with 8m spacing.
meera_sre: Created ticket ENG-PLAT-8819 to revisit defaults for tiny vs small gangs. Assigning jad_sched + taylor_infra.
ops-bot: canary ended at 6570001260: PASS. Proceeding with staged rollout unless objections.
